meta.title: Climbing and rest-day nutrition plan
meta.source_policy: Nutrition values are taken from Morrisons UK product pages for the named products.
meta.calculation_policy: Macros scale linearly from each product's nutrition_basis. Derived values are cached for static rendering but should be regenerated after edits.
important_notes: Raisins are removed. The climbing-day during-session item is one 42g Nature Valley Oats & Honey wrapper (two bars).
Tofu is the default pasta protein. Chicken is retained only as an optional variant.
Product labels and availability can change; check packaging when accuracy matters.
This is data modelling and arithmetic, not personalised medical or dietetic advice.
